node.statement: For every j and s in Sigma_j define iota_js:L_j->L_j tensor E_j by iota_js(z):=U_js z tensor xi_j and define Lambda_j:=sum_{s in Sigma_j}p_js*(Delta(hat-U_js^*) tensor I_F)V W_j^*iota_js; each iota_js and V is an isometry, Delta is UCP, ||W_j|| <= 1, and the p_js form a probability distribution, hence ||Lambda_j|| <= 1.
